html:
This full day tour takes you to two of Central Vietnam’s most iconic UNESCO World Heritage sites. Explore the mystical My Son Holy Land, the ancient religious sanctuary of the Champa Kingdom, and then stroll through the charming streets of Hoi An Ancient Town, famous for its well preserved architecture, cultural heritage, and peaceful atmosphere.

This tour is perfect for travelers who love history, culture, and authentic local experiences.

ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel. Depart for My Son Holy Land.

09:30
Arrive at My Son Holy Land – a unique sanctuary of the ancient Cham civilization.

Discover the sacred complex of moss-covered brick towers dating back to the 4th – 13th centuries, once the spiritual and political center of the Champa Kingdom.

Enjoy a traditional Cham music and dance performance, and visit the Tra Kieu Marian Pilgrimage Center, the site of the former capital of the Hindu Champa Kingdom.

11:30
Lunch at a local restaurant.

13:30
Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town. Enjoy a guided walking tour through this charming heritage town, visiting:

  • Ancient merchant houses

  • Fukien Chinese Assembly Hall

  • The 400-year-old Japanese Covered Bridge

  • Sa Huynh Museum

  • Local handicraft workshops

Free time for shopping and exploring the old town at your own pace.

16:00
Drop-off at your hotel.

End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel

TOUR PRICE: USD 52 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for transfers

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Lunch in Hoi An

  • Entrance fees to My Son Holy Land and Hoi An Ancient Town

  • Mineral water on the coach

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Please provide personal information: Full name, year of birth, gender, nationality, and contact details.

  • Children policy:

    • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (sharing lunch with parents)

    • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion lunch)

    • Above 9 years old: Full adult price
